name.fr-FR: Instructions pastorales sur les promesses de l’Église
name.en-US: Pastoral Instructions on the Promises of the Church
name.pt-BR: Instruções pastorais sobre as promessas da Igreja

description.fr-FR: Deux instructions pastorales contre le ministre Jurieu et son traité de l’Unité de l’Église : les promesses de Jésus-Christ à son Église, sa perpétuité visible et l’impossibilité qu’elle tombe dans l’erreur. Publiées en 1700. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Two pastoral instructions against the minister Jurieu and his treatise on the Unity of the Church: Christ’s promises to his Church, its visible perpetuity and the impossibility of its falling into error. Published in 1700. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Duas instruções pastorais contra o ministro Jurieu e seu tratado sobre a Unidade da Igreja: as promessas de Cristo à sua Igreja, sua perpetuidade visível e a impossibilidade de que ela caia no erro. Publicadas em 1700. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XVII, pages 003-004. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
